question: What function must the wind-filling air perform if it is to be present as that which is situated in all beings?
premises: The air is described as wind-filling.
It is said to be situated in all beings.
Its presence is posited universally throughout beings.
inference: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings as their pervasive vital presence.
uncertainties: The mode of its situatedness is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
